name: website-inspiration
description: Look at real, well-designed websites before designing one. A curated list of 17 design gallery sites, each matched to the part of the page it helps with (full landing pages, hero sections, pricing, calls to action, footers, dark mode, app screens and flows, fonts, portfolios, emails). Use before designing or redesigning a website, landing page, pricing page, hero section, footer, portfolio or marketing email, when a design looks generic, or when the user asks for design inspiration, references or examples.

compared.frontmatter:
name: interview-reel-motion
description: "Layer motion graphics on an already-cut 9:16 interview, vlog or talking-head short with HyperFrames (npx hyperframes, no app install): a cover frame for the feed grid, phrase captions, stickers, lower thirds, stat counters, typed prompts, a one-off particle takeover, eased framing pushes and card morphs, an interpolated speed ramp and a clean end hold, all driven by a beat map (beats.json), then gate the render with face-zone, safe-zone, readability, flash and caption checks in Python. Use when the cut and the voice are locked and the job is the graphic layer. Compound is an optional second engine for the same data. Not for cutting raw footage into a short (use vlog-edit), recutting a talking head with overlays from a script (use talking-head-recut), generating video from nothing, or motion graphics without a speaker."
compared.adopted: name/description + metadata.author/license; separate provenance manifest; executable helpers and starter template

compared.frontmatter:
name: realistic-water
description: Build an ultra-realistic open ocean in Three.js with a deep-water Gerstner spectrum shaded per pixel from analytic derivatives, each wave faded at its own pixel footprint, plus Fresnel sky-cube and planar reflections, subsurface light through the crests, HDR sun glitter, Jacobian lace foam, a Kelvin wake, hull foam, buoyancy queries and aerial perspective into the sky's horizon haze. Use for seas, oceans, sunset or daylight water, sun glitter paths, ship or boat scenes, wakes, coastal flyovers and any 3D scene with a moving camera and a water horizon. Includes the approved water from Pirate Ship Sunset as a reusable module and demo.
